**What changed and why**

**Checklist**

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, and `npm test` pass
- [ ] Tests live under `src/test/`, and a behavior change includes a test that failed before the fix
- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`/`fix:`/`docs:`/`chore:`/...); the changelog is written by hand at release time and the commit log is what it gets written from
